BiblicalUsage: Sâʻîyr carries the sense of a shower (as tempestuous). It stands in Deuteronomy 32:2: "…doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech…".
TheologicalSignificance: I hold sâʻîyr as God's own word, even if it appears only here.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
